breakfast.name: Kaya & Shokupan Set
breakfast.imageAlt: Golden shokupan with half-boiled eggs, pandan kaya and whipped butter
breakfast.description: Our take on the classic Singaporean–Malaysian breakfast. Soft, fluffy house-made milk bread served with fragrant pandan kaya, whipped butter and two half-boiled eggs. Enjoy with soy sauce and white pepper for the perfect balance of sweet and savoury.

breakfast.name: Lao Gan Ma Hot Honey Stracciatella
breakfast.imageAlt: Hot honey stracciatella with pistachios and toasted sourdough
breakfast.description: Creamy Italian stracciatella paired with sweet, lightly charred peaches and our Lao Gan Ma hot honey. Finished with toasted pistachios and served with sourdough for a playful combination of creamy, sweet, spicy and savoury flavours.

lunch.name: Balinese Pork Satay
lunch.imageAlt: Five Balinese pork skewers with cucumber pickles and coriander
lunch.description: Five skewers of aromatic marinated pork, caramelised and served with our smoky sweet soy sauce, refreshing house-made pickles and fresh coriander. Inspired by the bold, fragrant flavours of Balinese street food.

lunch.name: Singapore Chilli Crab Omurice
lunch.imageAlt: Crispy soft-shell crab over a silky omelette and chilli sauce
lunch.description: A whole crispy soft-shell crab served over a soft omelette and fragrant aromatic rice. Accompanied by our interpretation of Singapore’s iconic chilli crab sauce, with a touch of Indonesian Padang-style influence for added depth and complexity. Served with the sauce separately for pouring and a refreshing cucumber-cabbage salad dressed with coriander, ginger and lime.

lunch.name: Tea-Smoked Duck Inaniwa Udon
lunch.imageAlt: Chilled Inaniwa udon with sliced tea-smoked duck and soft-cooked egg
lunch.description: Delicate Inaniwa udon served chilled in our refreshing kankitsu tare, a citrus-infused Japanese-style sauce with savoury kombu umami and fragrant yuzu notes. Topped with slices of house-made tea-smoked duck breast with lightly crisped skin, a silky soft-cooked egg, shaved daikon, fragrant shiso and crispy Japanese rice crackers.

lunch.name: Vegan Sesame-Miso Ma Jiang Mian
lunch.imageAlt: Sesame-miso noodles with braised mushrooms, spring onion and chilli oil
lunch.description: Our Taiwanese-inspired sesame noodles feature delicate Inaniwa udon coated in a rich, nutty sesame-miso sauce. Topped with savoury braised shiitake and shredded king oyster mushrooms, refreshing cucumber, spring onion and fragrant vegan chilli oil.
